Subject: Discovery recap & POC proposal — Quintex AI

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the 45-minute call today — good conversation and lots of practical signals around where Redwood could move the needle. Below is a concise recap, proposed pilot scope, success metrics, and the immediate access/next-step checklist so we can lock a kickoff date.

Quick recap (pain + goals)
- Pain: high latency and unpredictable token costs on your current in-house LLM layer; quality regressions on longer prompts for multi-turn workflows.
- Goal: reduce per-request latency to <= 350ms P50 for interactive product flows and cut token spend by ~30% on high-volume routes while preserving or improving answer relevance on our prompt set.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks)
- Target workload: customer support summarization + intent classification endpoint (sample 10k requests/day distribution).
- Models: Redwood-curated open model baseline + quantized variant for cost testing.
- Activities: evaluation harness, prompt/eval set, dedicated capacity for two-week ramp, latency/cost profiling.

Success metrics (primary + guardrails)
- Primary: P50 latency <= 350ms; token cost reduction >= 25% vs baseline.
- Quality guardrail: top-1 relevance (labelled eval set) not below -2% compared to baseline.
- Ops: automated fallback to hosted model on capacity loss; zero PII ingestion in sample dataset.

Owners & roles
- Redwood: Markus Klein (eng sponsor), Aditya Rao (technical lead / infra), Monica Patel (CS & rollout owner).
- Quintex: Samir (technical), Priya (product).

Timeline (target)
- Week 0 (this week): confirm scope, sign POC order, grant access to a data bucket + test account.
- Week 1: environment provisioning, small smoke test, baseline metrics collection.
- Weeks 2–3: optimized serving (batching, caching), prompt sweeps, quantization trial.
- Week 4: final eval, handoff doc, recommendation + optional extended trial.

Immediate access checklist (what we need from Quintex)
1) S3 bucket read-only creds or a shared dataset export (sample 5–10k examples)
2) Test API key and a sample request/response pair for baseline profiling
3) Contact point for network/infra (VPN / firewall rules) if you require IP allowlisting

Attachments included in this message: POC-SOW-Quintex-v1.pdf (proposal + SOW), prompt-eval-template.csv (starter eval prompts).

Next steps
- Please confirm scope and which metrics we should prioritize (latency vs cost vs relevance).
- If happy, we'll circulate the POC order and propose two kickoff slots next week (Tue 4/14 10–11 PDT or Thu 4/16 9–10 PDT).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to clarify anything.

Best,
Markus Klein
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
